steps.title: Check the permission for your exact copy
steps.instruction: Fresh Windows and Linux v0.5.0 acquisition remains held. The package NOTICE excludes inherited decompilation code and assets from the MIT grant. Resume acquisition when permission for the exact package is established.

steps.title: Prepare your original in a permitted copy
steps.instruction: Keep the complete v0.5.0 folder. Place your own matching USA NTSC-U big-endian ROM at data/ge007.ntsc-final.z64. Run the upstream player in that folder to prepare its local assets before adding it.

steps.title: Use the matching native player
steps.instruction: Choose ge007.x86_64.exe on Windows or ge007.x86_64 on Linux, and use its containing folder as the start folder. The Linux x64 kit uses glibc 2.29 or newer, zlib, and its adjacent SDL2 library. Save your details in Portcove, then choose Play.

references.title: Preserve your actual data before changing copies
references.instruction: For an externally owned copy, preserve data/ge007.ntsc-final.z64, data/ge007.eep, data/ge007.ini, emulator-import backups and ppm screenshots, plus any selected custom locations. The upstream importer has 99 backup names and can overwrite its last slot when full. Keep generated sidecars and shader lists with their producing runtime; optional source/Python tools are separate deliberate actions. You or upstream provide external updates. Portcove registration does not update, back up, roll back or delete those external files.
